verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six were noisy while sitting in inhabited areas. … One should not be noisy while sitting in an inhabited area. If a monk, out of disrespect, is noisy while sitting in an inhabited area, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if he is the first offender. The fourth training rule is finished.
“‘I will not be noisy while sitting in inhabited areas,’ this is how you should train.”
